articles.titleCn: 中德汽车企业在行业变革中加强合作

As the presentations unfolded, Henkel found her view shifting fast and was deeply impressed by China's development {{14}}. paragraphs.en:
"It's a real eye-opener."
Liu Suyue, deputy director of the Hunan Provincial Department of Commerce, summarized Hunan's advantages as a favorable destination for German investment as "5C": cost, consumer base, a whole supply-chain cluster, a talent base of colleges and a convenient environment. "We are ready to work with you, and I believe our {{15}} can bridge the distance from the Xiang River to the Rhine," Liu said. Germany is home to several well-known companies from Hunan Province, including the Sany Group. A Chinese multinational heavy equipment manufacturer, Sany Group {{16}} Putzmeister, one of the world's leading construction equipment companies, in 2012. Michael Bose, chairman of the board at automotive BerlinBrandenburg e.V., also attended the meeting.
paragraphs.cn: “这真让人大开眼界。”湖南省商务厅副厅长刘素月将湖南作为德国投资理想目的地的优势概括为“5C”：成本、消费群体、全供应链集群、高校人才基地和便利环境。刘说：“我们愿与你们合作，我相信我们的诚意能跨越湘江到莱茵河的距离。”德国有多家湖南知名企业，包括三一集团。中国跨国重型设备制造商三一集团于2012年收购了世界领先的建筑设备公司之一普茨迈斯特。柏林-勃兰登堡汽车协会主席迈克尔·博泽也出席了会议。

paragraphs.en:
"I am pleased that we have the opportunity today to engage with Hunan-and specifically with its representatives, as well as potentially later with Sany Group to discuss vehicles and automotive technologies," he said. As the chairman of a German association representing companies from the special-purpose vehicle manufacturing sector, Bose is well aware that the German companies "currently have a very strong interest in, and are actively seeking contacts within, the electric vehicle industry, particularly regarding heavy trucks and heavy machinery in relation to China."
As a major manufacturing province in China, Hunan boasts a solid foundation in the automotive industry. These industrial {{17}} not only provide enterprises with supporting supply chains and opportunities for market expansion, but also create {{18}} room for China-Germany cooperation on new technologies and products, Liu Minqiang, the MOFCOM official, said in a speech at the meeting. "By aligning Hunan's promotion meeting with the Sino-German Automotive Congress today, our objective is to deepen the German community's understanding of Hunan," Liu Minqiang said. Uwe Fritsch, member relations specialist at automotiveland.nrw, an automotive industry cluster in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, also highlighted the importance of closer exchanges between China and Germany.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：“我很高兴今天有机会与湖南——特别是其代表，以及可能稍后与三一集团——就车辆和汽车技术进行交流。”作为代表专用车辆制造领域企业的德国协会主席，博泽深知德国企业“目前对电动汽车行业，特别是与中国相关的重型卡车和重型机械，有着非常浓厚的兴趣，并正在积极寻求接触”。作为中国制造业大省，湖南在汽车行业拥有坚实基础。商务部官员刘民强在会上发言说，这些产业能力不仅为企业提供配套供应链和市场拓展机会，也为中德新技术和新产品合作创造了充足空间。刘民强说：“通过将湖南推介会与今天的德中汽车大会相结合，我们的目标是加深德国各界对湖南的了解。”德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州汽车产业集群automotiveland.nrw的成员关系专家乌韦·弗里奇也强调了中国和德国之间更紧密交流的重要性。

paragraphs.en: "As Lower Saxony's Minister-President Olaf Lies has also pointed out, what we need is greater cooperation – and in both directions," Fritsch said. "This means not only closer economic collaboration between German and Chinese companies but also, equally importantly in the current climate, greater mutual understanding and dialogue."
paragraphs.cn: 弗里奇说：“正如下萨克森州州长奥拉夫·利斯也指出的，我们需要的是更大的合作——而且是双向的。这不仅意味着德中企业之间更紧密的经济合作，而且在当前环境下同样重要的是，加强相互理解和对话。”

articles.fullText:
Chinese and German auto companies on Friday explored ways to boost cooperation amid profound global transformation and fierce industry competition.
The 10th German-Chinese Automotive Congress was held in Wolfsburg, Germany, on Friday, attended by some 600 representatives from China and Germany.
The automotive industry, including its suppliers and technology sectors, is undergoing one of the biggest and most rapid transformation processes in its history, according to Olaf Lies, minister-president of Lower Saxony state.
A wide range of factors are driving this transformation, including electrification, vehicle digitalization, artificial intelligence in manufacturing and in vehicles themselves, and autonomous driving, Lies said, adding that the congress sends a strong signal that cooperation between Germany and China should be deepened.
In the auto industry's current climate, it is very important that German and Chinese companies maintain dialogue and establish reliable and solid partnerships, said Thomas Schmall, CEO of Volkswagen Group Technology.
Meanwhile, Liu Minqiang, director-general of the Investment Promotion Agency of the Chinese Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), said competition is not detrimental to the automotive industry as transformation accelerates.
Rather, it helps upgrade the industry and plays a positive role in providing customers with better products and services, Liu added, urging companies to focus on improving their technologies, products and services.
Lin Dong, China's consul general in Hamburg, added that cooperation between Chinese and German auto companies has now gone beyond the conventional domain of complete vehicle production, expanding to areas including batteries, intelligent connection and technological innovations.
The Automotive Congress was held in the wake of the International Suppliers Fair, which kicked off in Wolfsburg on Tuesday. A total of 45 Chinese automotive suppliers were present at the fair.
Hunan pitches '5C' advantages
The economic and trade cooperation and exchange conference between China's Hunan Province and Germany, which also took place on Friday, coincided with the German-Chinese Automotive Congress.
Representatives of the German automotive industry have responded positively to delegates from central China's Hunan Province.
On the sidelines of the meeting, Gundula Henkel, a board member of the German-Chinese Association Saxony-Anhalt, leaned in with a candid smile, holding a notebook filled with scribbled notes.
As the presentations unfolded, Henkel found her view shifting fast and was deeply impressed by China's development momentum. People can see "how cleverly (China's) local strengths are paired with the right industries," she remarked. "It's a real eye-opener."
Liu Suyue, deputy director of the Hunan Provincial Department of Commerce, summarized Hunan's advantages as a favorable destination for German investment as "5C": cost, consumer base, a whole supply-chain cluster, a talent base of colleges and a convenient environment.
"We are ready to work with you, and I believe our sincerity can bridge the distance from the Xiang River to the Rhine," Liu said.
Germany is home to several well-known companies from Hunan Province, including the Sany Group.
A Chinese multinational heavy equipment manufacturer, Sany Group acquired Putzmeister, one of the world's leading construction equipment companies, in 2012.
Michael Bose, chairman of the board at automotive BerlinBrandenburg e.V., also attended the meeting.
"I am pleased that we have the opportunity today to engage with Hunan-and specifically with its representatives, as well as potentially later with Sany Group to discuss vehicles and automotive technologies," he said.
As the chairman of a German association representing companies from the special-purpose vehicle manufacturing sector, Bose is well aware that the German companies "currently have a very strong interest in, and are actively seeking contacts within, the electric vehicle industry, particularly regarding heavy trucks and heavy machinery in relation to China."
As a major manufacturing province in China, Hunan boasts a solid foundation in the automotive industry. These industrial capabilities not only provide enterprises with supporting supply chains and opportunities for market expansion, but also create ample room for China-Germany cooperation on new technologies and products, Liu Minqiang, the MOFCOM official, said in a speech at the meeting.
"By aligning Hunan's promotion meeting with the Sino-German Automotive Congress today, our objective is to deepen the German community's understanding of Hunan," Liu Minqiang said.
Uwe Fritsch, member relations specialist at automotiveland.nrw, an automotive industry cluster in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, also highlighted the importance of closer exchanges between China and Germany.
"As Lower Saxony's Minister-President Olaf Lies has also pointed out, what we need is greater cooperation – and in both directions," Fritsch said. "This means not only closer economic collaboration between German and Chinese companies but also, equally importantly in the current climate, greater mutual understanding and dialogue."

articles.title: Digital Xiongan: How AI is shaping the smart 'City of the Future'
articles.titleCn: 数字雄安：AI如何塑造智能“未来之城”
articles.summary: Buildings have digital twins in the cloud-based platform, underground utility tunnels are monitored in real time, and traffic lights adjust to changing road conditions. In the Xiongan New Area in north China's Hebei Province, these futuristic scenarios have been part of everyday life.
articles.summaryCn: 雄安新区通过建设城市计算中心、数字孪生和AI应用，打造中国首个数字与物理基础设施同步规划的未来智能城市。

Often referred to as a "city of the future," Xiongan is China's first city to develop its digital and physical infrastructure {{4}} across the entire area. Early in the planning phase, the city {{5}} a concept of building "three cities" together – a city underground, a city above ground and a city in the cloud. paragraphs.cn: 建筑在云平台中拥有数字孪生体，地下管廊实时监控，交通信号灯根据路况变化自动调整。在中国北方河北省的雄安新区，这些未来场景已成为日常生活的一部分。智能城市的数字基础。雄安常被称为“未来之城”，是中国首个在全域范围内同步建设数字基础设施和物理基础设施的城市。在规划初期，城市就秉持“三座城”共建理念——地下城、地上城和云上城。雄安城市计算中心作为数字城市的“大脑”，为数字城市环境的发展提供关键支撑。

paragraphs.en:
It supplies computing, storage and network services for the entire digital twin city, enabling {{7}} urban planning, unified construction supervision and {{8}} city {{9}} through a shared digital platform. "If the digital twin city is a tree, the computing center is its roots and soil," said Liu Yao, manager of the information system department at the Xiongan Cloud Network Technology Co., Ltd. The center currently supports more than 100 categories of urban operational data from over 20 government departments in Xiongan, covering six major {{10}}, including geospatial information, Internet of Things (IoT) sensing and government services. In Rongdong District, lidar sensors and multifunctional roadside poles capture real-time traffic data and {{14}} it to the center, where AI algorithms analyze traffic conditions and {{15}} signal timings, allowing vehicles to run with fewer stops. This system has shortened morning and evening peak-hour travel times on major roads in the district by 15 minutes. In communities, a smart utility-meter system {{16}} real-time water, gas and heating {{17}} data, which also helps to monitor the daily activity patterns of older people living alone. Buildings have digital twins in the cloud-based platform, underground utility tunnels are monitored in real time, and traffic lights adjust to changing road conditions. In the Xiongan New Area in north China's Hebei Province, these futuristic scenarios have been part of everyday life.
A digital foundation for an intelligent city
Often referred to as a "city of the future," Xiongan is China's first city to develop its digital and physical infrastructure simultaneously across the entire area. Early in the planning phase, the city embraced a concept of building "three cities" together – a city underground, a city above ground and a city in the cloud.
The Xiongan Urban Computing Center serves as the "brain" of the digital city, providing essential support for the development of a digital urban environment. It supplies computing, storage and network services for the entire digital twin city, enabling integrated urban planning, unified construction supervision and coordinated city governance through a shared digital platform.
"If the digital twin city is a tree, the computing center is its roots and soil," said Liu Yao, manager of the information system department at the Xiongan Cloud Network Technology Co., Ltd.
The center currently supports more than 100 categories of urban operational data from over 20 government departments in Xiongan, covering six major dimensions, including geospatial information, Internet of Things (IoT) sensing and government services.
AI for smarter transport and urban management
The digital screen in the Xiongan Urban Computing Center. 
Powered by the center, a wide range of innovative applications has been deployed across the city, transforming people's everyday life.
On the roads, sensors collect real-time traffic data, allowing AI algorithms to adjust traffic-light timings and improve traffic flow. In Rongdong District, lidar sensors and multifunctional roadside poles capture real-time traffic data and transmit it to the center, where AI algorithms analyze traffic conditions and optimize signal timings, allowing vehicles to run with fewer stops. This system has shortened morning and evening peak-hour travel times on major roads in the district by 15 minutes.
In communities, a smart utility-meter system integrates real-time water, gas and heating consumption data, which also helps to monitor the daily activity patterns of older people living alone. When unusual data triggers an alert, the system automatically assigns a task to community workers, who will visit the resident to check the condition and provide assistance.
For urban management, an AI-powered video system helps detect issues such as illegal parking, overflowing waste bins and potential fire hazards. Once a problem is identified, the system can automatically generate a work order for the relevant personnel, connecting digital detection with practical action. Digital twin models of underground utility tunnels display real-time data on flow, water pressure, temperature and humidity, enabling remote inspections and helping identify potential risks. "Inspections of underground utility tunnels can be carried out in the digital environment, helping ensure the safe operation at all times," said Liu
So far, Xiongan has built more than 500 kilometers of digital roads and over 130 kilometers of digital utility tunnels, deployed more than one million sensing terminals and connected over 100,000 video terminals.
Fostering innovation through integration
Inside the Xiongan AI Practical Training Base, north China's Hebei Province, September 4, 2026. 
Xiongan is strengthening collaboration among industry, academia and research institutions to foster innovation and cultivate talent.
It is deepening partnerships with universities, including Tsinghua University, to advance joint research, accelerate the commercialization of research achievement and develop AI applications tailored to real-world needs. The city is also working to attract leading researchers and high-caliber talent to strengthen its innovation ecosystem.
By opening real-world application scenarios to technology companies, Xiongan provides a testing ground for new products and technologies, while businesses feed improved technologies back into urban operations.
By 2027, Xiongan aims to attract and nurture five unicorn companies, 10 enterprises valued at 5-billion-yuan (about $750 million) level and 100 leading enterprises.
From strengthening the digital infrastructure to expanding smart-city applications, and from fostering AI enterprises to attracting skilled talent, Xiongan is harnessing AI to advance its vision of a model smart city, and exploring approaches that could offer valuable insights for digital urban development worldwide.

articles.fullText:
A weather station (L) and a communication system at the simulated Mars exterior portion of NASA's CHAPEA mission at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas, August 22, 2025. 
The four members of a crew who took part in a simulated mission to Mars have emerged after 378 days in isolation at the US space agency's Johnson Space Center in Houston, an endeavor designed to help prepare for a possible future excursion by NASA astronauts to Earth's planetary neighbor.
"It's been a hell of a year – analog astronauts living in captivity of our own free will," Ellen Ellis, the medical officer on the Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog (CHAPEA) mission, said in remarks at Johnson Space Center after emerging with her three crewmates on Saturday.
The four entered the 158-square-meter 3D-printed habitat on October 19, 2025, and performed tasks such as growing crops in simulated Martian soil and interfacing with NASA officials, with delays recreating those inherent in interplanetary communications.
NASA's CHAPEA mission workroom at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas, August 22, 2025. 
NASA, which has explored Mars with robotic rovers and orbiting spacecraft, has ambitions for a human mission to Mars as early as the 2030s, with plans before that to return astronauts to the moon for the first time since 1972.
"We have a narrowing window of opportunity to maintain US preeminence in space," Ellis said.
Ellis mentioned the service academy for space-related operations pursued by the US President Donald Trump's administration and plans for a lunar base.
"Let's seize the initiative, lead with science that will benefit our economy and ensure our legacy in space for our children's children," Ellis said.
The other crew members were mission commander Ross Elder, science officer Matthew Montgomery and flight engineer James Spicer.
"For Mars, the risks are great," Elder said in remarks after emerging from isolation. "But through seeking understanding, strong vision and leadership, creativity, fortitude, hard work and incredible foundation, the goal of putting humans on Mars is not only achievable, but rather inevitable."
The crew is set to participate in two weeks of post-mission evaluations and debriefing with NASA scientists. NASA has said it is looking for insight into what it takes for astronauts to adapt to the routines and demands of daily life on long-duration missions beyond Earth to keep them healthy, productive and connected.
The recreation area of NASA's CHAPEA mission at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas, August 22, 2025. 
This was NASA's second CHAPEA mission, with another four-person crew in isolation at Johnson Space Center for 378 days spanning 2023 and 2024.
Vanessa Wyche, director of the Johnson Space Center, greeted the crew members when they exited isolation. Wyche said they managed to live with limited resources, maintain their habitat and carry out simulated Mars operations.
Wyche also noted how the crew dealt with the simulated interplanetary communications, with lag times between sending messages and receiving responses.
"These delays require patience, careful planning and greater independence – qualities that will be essential for future astronauts traveling millions of miles from home," Wyche said.
Wyche said the lessons learned from the CHAPEA crew and their experiences will help pave the way for the missions – first to the moon and "one day, Mars."

2026年10月26日至29日，中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议在中国北京举行。/新华社
世界多国政党领导人就中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议成功召开表示祝贺。他们高度评价中共在坚持不懈推进全面从严治党方面的经验和成就，并高度赞赏习近平党建思想为世界政党发展提供的重要启示。泰国民主党领袖、前总理阿披实·维乍集瓦表示，中共准确把握全球发展大势，回应人民根本诉求。他说，中共的治理实践和宝贵经验提供了有益借鉴，值得其他政党认真思考。尼泊尔共产党联合协调人、前总理马达夫·库马尔·尼帕尔表示，习近平党建思想回答了所有政党都必须面对但鲜有认真解决的问题。

他说，只有始终高度重视党的建设、勇于自我革新，一个政党才能引领国家走向持久和平与稳定。利比里亚团结党全国主席卢瑟·塔佩表示，中共成功的治理模式以可持续发展为民族复兴铺平了道路，为全球南方国家提供了宝贵经验。纳米比亚西南非洲人民组织（SWAPO）总书记索菲娅·沙宁瓦表示，中共中央总书记习近平为解决政党治理问题提供了有效方案。她说，SWAPO愿加强与中共的交流互鉴，系统研究习近平党建思想。坦桑尼亚革命党总书记阿莎-罗丝·米吉罗表示，此次会议将为中国式现代化和国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的成功实施巩固制度基础。乌干达全国抵抗运动总书记理查德·托德旺表示，中共加强党的建设的努力为实现中国式现代化提供了有力支撑，同时为包括非洲国家在内的发展中国家提升治理能力提供了宝贵模式。

俄罗斯联邦共产党中央委员会副主席、国家杜马国际事务委员会第一副主席德米特里·诺维科夫表示，中共的伟大之处在于其能够自我反思、直面问题并采取行动加以解决，这确保权力用于服务人民而非私人利益，并使党保持生机与活力。
